programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Garage Rehab
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings, the star of Discovery Channel's hit series `Fast N' Loud', knows what it takes to turn a dream into a full-fledged business empire. From the ground up, he built Dallas-based Gas Monkey Garage into a world-famous car restoration shop, gaining invaluable experience along the way. Now, Rawlings is ready to pass along that knowledge to help struggling garages in desperate need of transformation. Joined by project manager Russell J. Holmes and garage designer Chris Stephens, Richard takes on seemingly impossible challenges - dealing with out-of-touch owners, lazy employees, bad workflow and significant construction issues - and uses his entrepreneurial savvy, deep knowledge of the auto industry, and multifaceted marketing skills to produce profitable businesses. Russell gets the rehabs done on time and on budget, while Chris implements Richard's vision for the shop.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Car enthusiast Mike Brewer works alongside mechanics to give new life to rundown, classic automobiles in order to resell at a profit. Working with a limited budget, Mike's job is to find and purchase a vehicle and oversee all the necessary repairs - and usually there are plenty of them - giving tips along the way about electrics, structural issues, mechanics, cosmetic touches and finishing work. Once complete, the restored car is taken for a test drive, and then Mike negotiates the purchase price with a new owner. The first 13 seasons of `Wheeler Dealers' featured master mechanic Edd China as Brewer's sidekick.

programme.title: Car Kings
programme.desc: Beau Boeckmann and the crew resurrect a Pantera hot-rodded by Carroll Shelby for a secret project. Also, a famous client picks up his restored '68 Charger.

programme.title: Street Customs
programme.desc: Auto customising expert Ryan Friedlinghaus takes an unorthodox approach when it comes to managing his family of artisans and technicians at West Coast Customs in Corona, Calif., but time and again the team comes up with a car build that has street edge and craftsmanship.

programme.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten

programme.desc: The fastest cars and drivers on the circuit come together to battle one another for the ultimate bragging rights. Brian Lohnes, the NHRA and Hot Rod Drag Week announcer hosts the races.

programme.title: Garage Rehab
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings, the star of Discovery Channel's hit series `Fast N' Loud', knows what it takes to turn a dream into a full-fledged business empire. From the ground up, he built Dallas-based Gas Monkey Garage into a world-famous car restoration shop, gaining invaluable experience along the way. Now, Rawlings is ready to pass along that knowledge to help struggling garages in desperate need of transformation. Joined by project manager Russell J. Holmes and garage designer Chris Stephens, Richard takes on seemingly impossible challenges - dealing with out-of-touch owners, lazy employees, bad workflow and significant construction issues - and uses his entrepreneurial savvy, deep knowledge of the auto industry, and multifaceted marketing skills to produce profitable businesses. Russell gets the rehabs done on time and on budget, while Chris implements Richard's vision for the shop.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Frank's caught wildlife in the Brazilian jungle including a 400 lbs. White Jaguar. He ships it on the same ship as an arrested assassin. The assassin breaks free and frees the animals.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: Megan Fox is a battle-hardened mercenary in the wilds of Africa whose team has rescued hostages from a gang of murderous rebels and is trying to survive - against both the rebels and a pack of ravenous lions.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: Feels Like Hope
programme.desc: As the college fest approaches, Avi and Lakshay are teamed up together which leads to worse consequences for the two of them. Gandhi goes on a journey to find a new passion by participating in the fest, and Sameer pushes himself to face his fear of performing at the fest.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Ruhi needs a new phone and a scholarship, but also wants Lucky’s attention. Kenny wants to stand up for his rights but desperately needs help for the same.

programme.title: The Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Ruhi has second thoughts about her choices. Ayesha needs a story at any cost. Aparna is looking for payback. Meanwhile, Aditya makes some progress with the investigation.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Bhati and Gagan face off in a surprisingly close-fought election. Ruhi has a close shave in an outstation exam. Tarush suffers a setback.

programme.title: Brave New World
programme.desc: Ruhi gets a taste of the good life, briefly, before the shit hits the fan. Tarush takes matters into his own hands. Aparna needs to regain control of her show. Bijoy smells a rat.

programme.title: Vanity Fair
programme.desc: Bhati overcommits to a sponsor and faces a logistical nightmare. Tarush follows the breadcrumbs. Everyone crosses paths at the college festival. Well, almost.

programme.title: The Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: Ayesha looks for missing books. Bijoy starts putting things together. Lucky finds himself in trouble. But Nadeem has bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: The Return of the Native
programme.desc: Lucky comforts a guilt-ridden Ruhi. Aarti makes a shocking discovery. Ayesha takes a trip. Bhati faces unexpected resistance. Gagan opens Aparna’s eyes.

programme.title: Bengaluru Hilaa Denge
programme.desc: Pradeep Bhaiyya, an annoying cousin shows up and takes Akhil and Rinzing for a drunken night. Kay sees Aryan making out. Vasudha, frustrated with her subtly sexist boss, heads out to a new age experience and hooks up with a much younger flute player.

programme.title: Braaazilll!!
programme.desc: Vasudha finally manages to have sex. Akhil is struggling to find his groove at the office, ends up meeting an unconventionally attractive girl, and is blown away. By the end, both Vasu and Akhil confront some seriously painful realities of their lives.

programme.title: Waise Wale Bhai Behen
programme.desc: Vasudha and Akhil forget to tie rakhis to each other on Raksha Bandhan. Vasudha loses her patience with her boss Satvik and impulsively resigns from Proficient. Akhil meets a bizarre therapist. He also finds an unlikely yet intriguing match on Kechup.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Skyfire
programme.desc: Characters from different backgrounds are thrown together when the plane they're travelling on crashes into the Pacific Ocean. A nightmare fight for survival ensues with the air supply running out and dangers creeping in from all sides.

programme.title: Way Down
programme.desc: A fever dream action film that follows Boy, a deaf person with a vibrant imagination. When his family is murdered, he is trained by a mysterious shaman to repress his childish imagination and become an instrument of death.

programme.title: Feels Like Home
programme.desc: The college fest begins but the boys are divided and on their own journeys. But will the fest bring the boys back together or will this be the end of their home together?

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Founded by a devout Christian after having a paranormal encounter, The Tennessee Wraith Chasers investigate the most haunted towns in the United States. The team employs courage, wits and technology to find the truth behind the mystery.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: A retelling of the truly chilling, real-life stories of people who shared their homes and their lives with loved ones who turned into killers. Plus, interviews and firsthand accounts of the critical moments leading up to the vicious acts.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: A retelling of the truly chilling, real-life stories of people who shared their homes and their lives with loved ones who turned into killers. Plus, interviews and firsthand accounts of the critical moments leading up to the vicious acts.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies

programme.desc: Not every mother and father raise the child of their dreams, as some children grow up to become killers. Through heart-stopping stories, parents must come face to face with the horrible truth that the child they loved and trusted is a monster.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'
